THE LOCAL MEANING

What it is.

A Manitoba ice trip for Lake Winnipeg walleye, locally called greenbacks. Pickerel is another Canadian common name used here for walleye. It does not mean chain pickerel in this trip description.

How it is fished.

Fish jigs and bait through ice.

The research describes jigs and bait through the ice. Ask the guide how the party reaches the fishing area, what shelter is available, and how access decisions are made. Winter is the supported season context. Exact access dates remain dependent on ice conditions, not a fixed month alone.

Planning format: Full day or multi-day; guided ice trip. Confirm the actual duration with the provider.

Before you go.

Does pickerel mean chain pickerel on this page?

No. In this local usage, pickerel means walleye. The standard species name is walleye; chain pickerel is a different fish.

What seasonal window does the evidence support?

Winter; exact access dates depend on ice. A seasonal account does not confirm current availability. Use the linked authority for current rules.

What must I confirm before I book this trip?

Confirm transport, shelter, heat, drilled holes, bait, and tackle. Ask about emergency communications and the day’s access decision. Confirm the Manitoba license and current Lake Winnipeg rules for the trip. Castward has no confirmed guide inventory for this trip type.
